title: 1:1 with a manager
description: The user (mic) and their manager Dana (far end). Promotion settled explicitly, handover settled, conference budget settled implicitly, vacation dates discussed but not settled, demo feedback; weekend and kitchen small talk as tangents.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Hi Sam, good to see you. How was your weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Really nice, thanks. We finally went hiking up by the lake, and the weather was perfect.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Lovely. I stood in the rain watching my niece's football match.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Ha, brave. Okay, I have a few things today. First, the promotion to senior. What is still missing?

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Honestly, not much. The committee wants to see you lead a cross-team project from start to finish.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Would the billing export migration count? It touches three teams.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: It would. The committee meets in March.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: So if I lead the migration, you would put me forward in March?

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Yes. Agreed: you lead the migration, and I will nominate you for senior in March.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Great, thank you. Next, the handover of the nightly billing export job, since I am moving onto the migration.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Who did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Priya. She already knows the reporting side.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Good choice. Make sure she has access to the dashboards and the alerts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I will pair with her on Monday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Then that's settled. Priya owns the nightly export from Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Third thing. There is a platform engineering conference in Berlin in November. It is about nine hundred euros with the hotel.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: That is exactly the migration work we need. Book it, and I'll approve the expense when it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Brilliant. Then vacation. I would like the last two weeks of December off.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Hmm. Half the team has asked for those same weeks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I could take the week before Christmas instead, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Maybe. Let me check the team calendar before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sure, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Before I forget, I wanted to give you feedback on last week's demo.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Please, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: The content was clear and the customers liked it, but you ran ten minutes over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Fair. I had too many slides.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Next time, cut it to five slides and do a dry run with me the day before.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Will do. Five slides and a dry run.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: By the way, did you see they are repainting the kitchen upstairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I did. The smell is everywhere.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Anything else from you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: No, that's everything. Thanks Dana.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Thanks Sam, talk next week.
